g.data-qualified-name: Beta . Railway .ADR-0023 platform. ADR-0024 build. ADR-0025 media..GMN40
g.text: ADR-0025. Seeded demo images stay OUT of
here — they ship inside the image at
disk, and survive a redeploy by being IN
volume, which is what makes an uploaded
image survive a redeploy for the first time.
The Local/Forge gap is why deploy-and-host.md's checklist exists
for THAT pairing — anything fixed only in this repo's
docker/nginx/*.conf, or only in the local .env, is invisible
to a Forge VPS and has to be set again, deliberately, there.
Railway has no equivalent gap: Railpack builds its own image,
so docker/nginx/*.conf was never relevant to it — a different
reason the same file cannot be assumed to cover Railway too.
As of this diagram, Railway deploys have not yet succeeded;
Forge has never been provisioned at all. Local is the only
topology actually verified running end to end.
